SELECT
A.DANSOK_ASGN_CD,
B.ASGN_FULL_NM AS DANSOK_ASGN_NM
FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
X.CMPNY_DIV,
X.BSNS_CD,
X.DEPT_CD,
X.ASGN_CD AS DANSOK_ASGN_CD
FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
P.CMPNY_DIV,
P.BSNS_CD,
P.DEPT_CD,
P.ASGN_CD
FROM (
SELECT
T1.CMPNY_DIV,
TZA.BSNS_CD,
TZA.DEPT_CD,
TZA.ASGN_CD
FROM (
SELECT
CMPNY_DIV,
DANSOK_EMP_NO
FROM TFA1010C01
WHERE CMPNY_DIV = #{CMPNY_DIV}
UNION ALL
SELECT
CMPNY_DIV,
CRADN_EMP_NO AS DANSOK_EMP_NO
FROM TGB3011C01
WHERE CMPNY_DIV = #{CMPNY_DIV}
) T1
JOIN TZA1010C01 TZA
ON T1.CMPNY_DIV = TZA.CMPNY_DIV
AND T1.DANSOK_EMP_NO = TZA.EMP_NO
WHERE TZA.HLD_OFFI_GBN <> '3'
AND TZA.BSNS_CD LIKE #{DANSOK_BSNS_CD} || '%'
) P
) X
JOIN VZZ1020C01 V
ON X.CMPNY_DIV = V.CMPNY_DIV
AND X.BSNS_CD = V.BSNS_CD
AND X.DEPT_CD = V.DEPT_CD
AND X.ASGN_CD = V.ASGN_CD
) A
JOIN VZZ1020C01 B
ON A.CMPNY_DIV = B.CMPNY_DIV
AND A.BSNS_CD = B.BSNS_CD
AND A.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD
AND A.DANSOK_ASGN_CD = B.ASGN_CD
ORDER BY B.ORGN_DIV, A.DANSOK_ASGN_CD

WITH base AS (
SELECT
a.cmpny_div,
a.vio_no,
a.bsns_cd,
a.dept_cd,
a.asgn_cd,
a.vio_emp_no,
a.violator,
a.io_div,
a.vio_gdiv,
a.vio_mdiv,
get_code_nm(
a.cmpny_div,
a.cmpny_div || 'G110',
a.vio_gdiv
) AS vio_gdiv_nm,
get_code_nm(
a.cmpny_div,
a.cmpny_div || 'G110' || a.vio_gdiv,
a.vio_mdiv
) AS vio_mdiv_nm,
xx10.get_location_desc(
a.cmpny_div,
concat(
a.vio_lplc,
a.vio_mplc,
a.vio_splc
)
) AS vio_splc_nm,
a.vio_desc,
a.vio_lplc,
a.vio_mplc,
a.vio_splc,
a.vio_plc_desc,
a.dansok_asgn_cd,
a.dansok_emp_no,
a.dansok_dept_cd,
get_emp_info(
a.cmpny_div,
a.dansok_emp_no,
'JOB_TIT_NM'
) AS dansok_job_tit_nm,
a.file_id1,
a.file_id2,
a.img_id1,
a.img_id2,
a.vio_time,
CASE
WHEN a.vio_time ~ '^[0-9]{8,12}$'
THEN to_date(
substring(a.vio_time, 1, 8),
'YYYYMMDD'
)
END AS vio_dt1,
CASE
WHEN a.vio_time ~ '^[0-9]{12}$'
THEN substring(a.vio_time, 9, 4)
END AS vio_time2,
CASE
WHEN a.vio_time ~ '^[0-9]{12}$'
THEN to_char(
to_timestamp(a.vio_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI'),
'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI'
)
END AS vio_time_ds,
b.asgn_full_nm AS asgn_nm,
b.asgn_shrt_nm AS team_nm,
get_emp_info(
a.cmpny_div,
a.vio_emp_no,
'JOB_TIT_CD'
) AS job_tit_cd,
get_emp_info(
a.cmpny_div,
a.vio_emp_no,
'JOB_TIT_NM'
) AS job_tit_nm,
a.act_bsns_cd,
a.actor,
a.act_emp_no,
get_emp_info(
a.cmpny_div,
a.act_emp_no,
'JOB_TIT_NM'
) AS act_job_tit_nm,
a.act_dept_cd,
a.act_phone,
a.act_rslt,
a.act_div,
get_dept_info7(
a.cmpny_div,
a.act_bsns_cd,
a.act_dept_cd,
get_emp_info(
a.cmpny_div,
a.act_emp_no,
'ASGN_CD'
),
'ASGN_FULL_NM'
) AS act_asgn_nm,
a.app_same,
a.app_asgn_cd,
a.app_dept,
a.app_emp_no,
(
SELECT e.kor_nm
FROM xx10.tza1010c01 e
WHERE e.cmpny_div = a.cmpny_div
AND e.emp_no = a.app_emp_no
LIMIT 1
) AS app_emp_nm,
get_code_nm(
a.cmpny_div,
a.cmpny_div || 'Z020',
a.io_div
) AS io_div_nm,
a.vend_name,
a.vend_cd,
a.ship_no,
a.company,
a.vehicle_type,
a.vehicle_car_no,
a.vehicle_reg_no,
a.vehicle_speed,
a.check_target_obj1,
a.check_target_obj2,
a.check_target_obj3,
a.sago_div_l,
a.sago_div_m,
a.sago_div_s,
a.insert_date,
a.insert_user_id,
a.status
FROM xx10.tfa1010c01 a
LEFT JOIN xx10.vzz1020c03 b
ON b.cmpny_div = a.company
AND b.bsns_cd = a.bsns_cd
AND b.dept_cd = a.dept_cd
AND b.asgn_cd = a.asgn_cd
WHERE (
NULLIF(#{CMPNY_DIV}, '') IS NULL
OR a.cmpny_div = #{CMPNY_DIV}
)
AND (
NULLIF(#{STATUS}, '') IS NULL
OR a.status = #{STATUS}
)
AND (
NULLIF(#{COMPANY}, '') IS NULL
OR a.company = #{COMPANY}
)
AND (
NULLIF(#{BSNS_CD}, '') IS NULL
OR a.bsns_cd = #{BSNS_CD}
)
AND (
NULLIF(#{DEPT_CD}, '') IS NULL
OR a.dept_cd = #{DEPT_CD}
)
AND (
NULLIF(#{ASGN_CD}, '') IS NULL
OR a.asgn_cd = #{ASGN_CD}
)
AND (
NULLIF(#{VIO_DATE_FR}, '') IS NULL
OR substring(a.vio_time, 1, 8)
BETWEEN replace(#{VIO_DATE_FR}, '-', '')
AND coalesce(
nullif(
replace(#{VIO_DATE_TO}, '-', ''),
''
),
'99991231'
)
)
)
SELECT
b.cmpny_div,
b.vio_no,
b.bsns_cd,
b.dept_cd,
'A' AS gubun,
b.asgn_cd,
b.vio_emp_no,
b.violator,
b.io_div,
b.vio_gdiv,
b.vio_mdiv,
b.vio_gdiv_nm,
b.vio_mdiv_nm,
b.vio_splc_nm,
b.vio_desc,
b.vio_lplc,
b.vio_mplc,
b.vio_splc,
b.vio_plc_desc,
coalesce(
b.dansok_asgn_cd,
k.asgn_cd
) AS dansok_asgn_cd,
b.dansok_emp_no,
k.kor_nm AS dansok_emp_nm,
b.dansok_dept_cd,
b.dansok_job_tit_nm,
(
SELECT o.asgn_full_nm
FROM xx10.vzz1020c03 o
WHERE o.cmpny_div = k.cmpny_div
AND o.asgn_cd = coalesce(
b.dansok_asgn_cd,
k.asgn_cd
)
AND o.dept_cd = coalesce(
b.dansok_dept_cd,
k.dept_cd
)
LIMIT 1
) AS dansok_asgn_nm,
b.vio_time,
b.vio_dt1,
b.vio_time2,
b.vio_time_ds,
b.status,
b.file_id1,
b.file_id2,
b.img_id1,
b.img_id2,
(
SELECT o.asgn_shrt_nm
FROM xx10.vzz1020c03 o
WHERE o.cmpny_div = b.company
AND o.asgn_cd = b.bsns_cd
LIMIT 1
) AS bsns_nm,
(
SELECT o.asgn_shrt_nm
FROM xx10.vzz1020c03 o
WHERE o.cmpny_div = b.company
AND o.asgn_cd = b.dept_cd
LIMIT 1
) AS dept_nm,
b.asgn_nm,
b.team_nm,
b.job_tit_cd,
b.job_tit_nm,
coalesce(
CASE
WHEN b.asgn_nm IS NULL THEN (
SELECT c.comp_nm
FROM xx10.support_c10_txxccomp_n c
WHERE c.comp_cd = b.asgn_cd
LIMIT 1
)
WHEN position(
'-' IN substring(
b.asgn_nm,
position('-' IN b.asgn_nm) + 1
)
) = 0 THEN ''
ELSE substring(
substring(
b.asgn_nm,
position('-' IN b.asgn_nm) + 1
),
position(
'-' IN substring(
b.asgn_nm,
position('-' IN b.asgn_nm) + 1
)
) + 1
)
END,
get_dept_info(
b.cmpny_div,
get_emp_info(
b.cmpny_div,
b.vio_emp_no,
'ASGN_CD'
),
'ASGN_SHRT_NM'
)
) AS dtl_asgn_nm,
b.act_bsns_cd,
b.actor,
b.act_emp_no,
b.act_job_tit_nm,
b.act_dept_cd,
b.act_asgn_nm,
b.act_phone,
b.act_rslt,
b.act_div,
b.app_same,
b.app_asgn_cd,
b.app_dept,
b.app_emp_no,
b.app_emp_nm,
b.io_div_nm,
b.vend_name,
b.vend_cd,
b.ship_no,
b.company,
b.vehicle_type,
b.vehicle_car_no,
b.vehicle_reg_no,
b.vehicle_speed,
b.check_target_obj1,
b.check_target_obj2,
b.check_target_obj3,
b.sago_div_l,
b.sago_div_m,
b.sago_div_s,
get_code_nm(
b.cmpny_div,
b.cmpny_div || 'B010',
b.sago_div_l
) AS sago_div_l_nm,
get_code_nm(
b.cmpny_div,
b.cmpny_div || 'B010' || b.sago_div_l,
b.sago_div_m
) AS sago_div_m_nm,
get_code_nm(
b.cmpny_div,
b.cmpny_div || 'B010'
|| b.sago_div_l
|| b.sago_div_m,
b.sago_div_s
) AS sago_div_s_nm,
get_code_nm(
b.cmpny_div,
b.cmpny_div || 'B040',
b.check_target_obj1
) AS check_target_obj1_nm,
get_code_nm(
b.cmpny_div,
b.cmpny_div || 'B040'
|| b.check_target_obj1,
b.check_target_obj2
) AS check_target_obj2_nm,
get_code_nm(
b.cmpny_div,
b.cmpny_div || 'B040'
|| b.check_target_obj1
|| b.check_target_obj2,
b.check_target_obj3
) AS check_target_obj3_nm,
0 AS vio_cnt_a,
0 AS vio_cnt_b,
0 AS vio_cnt_c,
0 AS vio_cnt,
to_char(
b.insert_date,
'YYYY-MM-DD'
) AS rg_date,
coalesce(
get_dept_info(
b.company,
get_emp_info(
b.company,
b.vio_emp_no,
'ASGN_CD'
),
'ASGN_FULL_NM'
),
get_dept_info7(
b.cmpny_div,
b.bsns_cd,
b.dept_cd,
get_emp_info(
b.cmpny_div,
b.vio_emp_no,
'ASGN_CD'
),
'ASGN_SHRT_NM'
)
) AS vio_emp_asgn,
b.insert_user_id
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN xx10.tza1010c01 k
ON k.cmpny_div = b.cmpny_div
AND k.emp_no = b.dansok_emp_no
WHERE (
NULLIF(#{VIO_GDIV}, '') IS NULL
OR b.vio_gdiv = #{VIO_GDIV}
)
AND (
NULLIF(#{DANSOK_BSNS_CD}, '') IS NULL
OR k.bsns_cd = #{DANSOK_BSNS_CD}
)
AND (
NULLIF(#{DANSOK_ASGN_CD}, '') IS NULL
OR coalesce(
b.dansok_asgn_cd,
k.asgn_cd
) = #{DANSOK_ASGN_CD}
)
AND (
NULLIF(#{DANSOK_EMP_NO}, '') IS NULL
OR b.dansok_emp_no = #{DANSOK_EMP_NO}
)
ORDER BY b.vio_time DESC;

SELECT cmpny_div AS "CMPNY_DIV"
, comm_id AS "COMM_ID"
,
bsns_cd AS "BSNS_CD"
, parent_comm_id AS "PARENT_COMM_ID"
, code_nm AS
"CODE_NM"
, order_num AS "ORDER_NUM"
FROM tb_com_work_standard_type
WHERE cmpny_div = #{CMPNY_DIV}
AND bsns_cd = #{BSNS_CD}
AND
parent_comm_id = #{COMM_ID}
ORDER BY order_num, comm_id

WITH RECURSIVE TMPTBL AS (
SELECT *
FROM (
SELECT CMPNY_DIV, ALL_UP_CD,
ALL_SYS_CD, UP_CD AS UP_COD, SYS_CD AS COD,
SYS_CDNM AS TXT,
CODE_SHORTNM
, CODE_DESC1, CODE_DESC2, CODE_DESC3, CODE_DESC4,
CODE_DESC5, USE_FLAG,
ORDER_NUM, DEFAULT_FLAG
FROM TB_COM_SYSTEMCODE
WHERE CMPNY_DIV = #{CMPNY_DIV}
AND ALL_SYS_CD LIKE #{CMPNY_DIV} ||
'G110%'
AND USE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND COALESCE(CODE_DESC2, 'N') <> 'Y'
AND COALESCE(CODE_DESC3, 'N') <> 'N'
AND COALESCE(CODE_DESC4,
'N') <> 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT CMPNY_DIV, ALL_UP_CD, ALL_SYS_CD,
UP_CD AS UP_COD, SYS_CD AS COD,
SYS_CDNM AS TXT, CODE_SHORTNM
,
CODE_DESC1, CODE_DESC2, CODE_DESC3, CODE_DESC4, CODE_DESC5, USE_FLAG,
ORDER_NUM, DEFAULT_FLAG
FROM TB_COM_SYSTEMCODE
WHERE CMPNY_DIV =
#{CMPNY_DIV}
AND ALL_SYS_CD LIKE #{CMPNY_DIV} || 'G110%'
AND USE_FLAG =
'Y'
AND COALESCE(CODE_DESC2, 'N') = 'Y'
AND (CODE_DESC1 IS NULL OR
CODE_DESC1 = 'COMM' OR CODE_DESC1 =
#{BSNS_CD})
AND COALESCE(CODE_DESC4,
'N') <> 'Y'
ORDER BY ORDER_NUM, COD
) BASE
),
HIERARCHY_QUERY AS (
SELECT
1 AS LVL,
',' || COD AS PATH,
CMPNY_DIV, ALL_UP_CD, ALL_SYS_CD, UP_COD, COD, TXT, CODE_SHORTNM
,
CODE_DESC1, CODE_DESC2, CODE_DESC3, CODE_DESC4, DEFAULT_FLAG
FROM
TMPTBL
WHERE ALL_UP_CD = #{CMPNY_DIV} || 'G110'
AND CMPNY_DIV =
#{CMPNY_DIV}
UNION ALL
SELECT
H.LVL + 1 AS LVL,
H.PATH || ',' || T.COD AS PATH,
T.CMPNY_DIV,
T.ALL_UP_CD, T.ALL_SYS_CD, T.UP_COD, T.COD, T.TXT, T.CODE_SHORTNM
,
T.CODE_DESC1, T.CODE_DESC2, T.CODE_DESC3, T.CODE_DESC4,
T.DEFAULT_FLAG
FROM TMPTBL T
INNER JOIN HIERARCHY_QUERY H
ON H.ALL_SYS_CD = T.ALL_UP_CD
AND T.CMPNY_DIV = #{CMPNY_DIV}
)
SELECT
TXT, LVL, PATH, CMPNY_DIV, ALL_UP_CD, ALL_SYS_CD,
UP_COD, COD,
CODE_SHORTNM
, CODE_DESC1, CODE_DESC2, CODE_DESC3,
CODE_DESC4, DEFAULT_FLAG
FROM HIERARCHY_QUERY
WHERE LVL = 2

SELECT
B.JOB_TIT_NM AS APP_JOB,
B.KOR_NM AS APP_EMP_NM,
B.EMP_NO AS
APP_EMP_NO,
B.OFFI_RES_CD,
B.EMAIL
FROM TZB1010C01 A
JOIN TZB1010C01 B
ON
A.CMPNY_DIV = B.CMPNY_DIV
AND A.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD
WHERE A.CMPNY_DIV = #{cmpnyDiv}
AND A.EMP_NO = #{dansokEmpNo}
AND TRIM(B.OFFI_RES_CD) IS NOT
NULL
AND B.HLD_OFFI_GBN = '1'
AND B.OFFI_RES_CD NOT IN ('15Z');

SELECT A.*
, A.ASGN_NM_TEMP
|| (CASE
WHEN A.DEPT_CD != A.ASGN_CD AND A.ASGN_NM_TEMP2 IS NOT NULL
THEN '-' || A.ASGN_NM_TEMP2
ELSE ''
END) AS ASGN_NM
FROM (
SELECT A.CMPNY_DIV
, A.JSTOP_NO
, A.BSNS_CD
, A.DEPT_CD
, (SELECT O.ASGN_SHRT_NM FROM XX10.VZZ1020C03 O WHERE O.CMPNY_DIV = A.COMPANY AND O.ASGN_CD = A.DEPT_CD LIMIT 1 ) AS DEPT_NM
, A.ASGN_CD
, A.CHG_EMP_NO
, get_emp_info(A.CMPNY_DIV, A.CHG_EMP_NO, 'JOB_TIT_NM' ) AS JOB_TIT_NM
, A.FILE_ID
, A.JOB_LPLC
, A.JOB_MPLC
, A.JOB_SPLC
, get_location_desc(A.CMPNY_DIV, concat(A.JOB_LPLC, A.JOB_MPLC, A.JOB_SPLC)) AS JOB_SPLC_NM
, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(A.JSTOP_TIME FROM 1 FOR 8), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JSTOP_DT
, TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(A.JSTOP_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS JSTOP_TIME
, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(A.RESTART_TIME FROM 1 FOR 8), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RESTART_DT
, CASE
WHEN A.RESTART_TIME ~ '^[0-9]{12}$'
THEN TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(A.RESTART_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI'), 'HH24:MI')
ELSE NULL
END AS RESTART_TIME
, COALESCE(
B.ASGN_FULL_NM
, (SELECT MAX(ASGN_FULL_NM)
FROM VZZ1020C01
WHERE CMPNY_DIV = COALESCE(A.COMPANY, A.CMPNY_DIV)
AND ASGN_CD = A.DEPT_CD)
) AS ASGN_NM_TEMP
, COALESCE(
(SELECT MAX(ASGN_SHRT_NM)
FROM VZZ1020C03
WHERE CMPNY_DIV = COALESCE(A.COMPANY, A.CMPNY_DIV)
AND ASGN_CD = A.ASGN_CD)
) AS ASGN_NM_TEMP2
, B.ASGN_SHRT_NM AS TEAM_NM
, A.CHG_EMP_NO
, GET_EMP_INFO(#{CMPNY_DIV}, A.CHG_EMP_NO, 'EMP_NM') AS CHG_EMP_NM
, A.WORKER_CNT
, GET_CODE_NM(#{CMPNY_DIV}, #{CMPNY_DIV} || '2010' || A.JOB_LPLC || A.JOB_MPLC, A.JOB_SPLC) AS JOB_SPLC_NM
, GET_CODE_NM('HHI', 'HHI' || '2010' || A.JOB_LPLC, A.JOB_MPLC) AS JOB_MPLC_NM
, GET_CODE_NM('HHI', 'HHI' || '2010', A.JOB_LPLC) AS JOB_LPLC_NM
, GET_ASGN_SHORT_NM(#{CMPNY_DIV}, A.ASGN_CD) AS ASGN_SHRT_NM
, A.JSTOP_EMP_NO
, A.JSTOP_ASGN_CD
, GET_EMP_INFO( A.CMPNY_DIV, A.JSTOP_EMP_NO, 'JOB_TIT_NM' ) AS JSTOP_JOB_TIT_NM
, A.JSTOP_DEPT_CD
,(SELECT E.KOR_NM FROM TZA1010C01 E WHERE E.CMPNY_DIV = A.CMPNY_DIV AND E.EMP_NO = A.JSTOP_EMP_NO LIMIT 1) AS JSTOP_EMP_NM
, GET_DEPT_INFO7(A.CMPNY_DIV, A.JSTOP_BSNS_CD, A.JSTOP_DEPT_CD, GET_EMP_INFO(A.CMPNY_DIV, A.JSTOP_EMP_NO, 'ASGN_CD'),'ASGN_FULL_NM') AS JSTOP_ASGN_NM
, A.JOB_PLC_DESC
, A.JSTOP_DESC
, GET_CODE_NM(#{CMPNY_DIV}, #{CMPNY_DIV} || 'G170', A.RESTART_DIV) AS RESTART_DIV_NM
, A.RESTART_DIV
, A.RESTART_DESC
, CASE
WHEN A.RESTART_TIME ~ '^[0-9]{12}$'
THEN ROUND(
(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
TO_TIMESTAMP(A.RESTART_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI')
- TO_TIMESTAMP(A.JSTOP_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI')
)) / 3600.0) * A.WORKER_CNT
, 1)
ELSE NULL
END AS LOSS_TIME
, A.SHIP_NO
, A.SAGO_DIV_L
, A.SAGO_DIV_M
, A.SAGO_DIV_S
, GET_CODE_NM(A.CMPNY_DIV, A.CMPNY_DIV || 'B010', A.SAGO_DIV_L) AS SAGO_DIV_L_NM
, GET_CODE_NM(A.CMPNY_DIV, A.CMPNY_DIV || 'B010' || A.SAGO_DIV_L, A.SAGO_DIV_M) AS SAGO_DIV_M_NM
, GET_CODE_NM(A.CMPNY_DIV, A.CMPNY_DIV || 'B010' || A.SAGO_DIV_L || A.SAGO_DIV_M, A.SAGO_DIV_S) AS SAGO_DIV_S_NM
, A.COMPANY
, A.IMG_ID
, A.IMG_ID2
, A.FILE_ID2
FROM TFA1050C01 A
LEFT JOIN VZZ1020C03 B
ON A.COMPANY = B.COMPANY
AND A.BSNS_CD = B.BSNS_CD
AND A.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD
AND A.ASGN_CD = B.ASGN_CD
WHERE A.CMPNY_DIV = #{CMPNY_DIV}
AND A.BSNS_CD = #{BSNS_CD}
AND A.DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}
AND SUBSTRING(A.JSTOP_TIME FROM 1 FOR 8)
BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{JSTOP_DATE_FR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMMDD')
AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{JSTOP_DATE_TO}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMMDD')
AND RESTART_DIV = #{RESTART_DIV}
) A
ORDER BY A.JSTOP_DT DESC

SELECT
a.cmpny_div,
a.mng_no,
b.asgn_full_nm AS send_asgn_nm,
CASE
WHEN LENGTH(a.rec_asgn_cd) < 5
THEN get_dept_info(a.cmpny_div, get_emp_info(a.cmpny_div, a.mng_no, 'ASGN_CD'), 'ASGN_FULL_NM')
ELSE (
SELECT asgn_full_nm
FROM tzb1020c03
WHERE dept_cd = a.rec_dept_cd
AND asgn_cd = a.rec_asgn_cd
LIMIT 1
)
END AS rec_asgn_nm,
d.sys_cdnm || (
CASE
WHEN e.sys_cdnm IS NULL THEN ''
ELSE ' / ' || e.sys_cdnm
END
) AS target_facility_nm,
g.sys_cdnm AS sago_div_nm,
a.problem_desc,
TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.noti_dt, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS noti_dt,
TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.req_reply_dt, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS req_reply_dt,
COALESCE(h.sys_cdnm, '작성중') AS status_nm,
COALESCE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.act_dt, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') AS act_dt,
GET_EMP_INFO(a.cmpny_div, a.chk_emp_no, 'EMP_NM') as chk_emp_nm,

get_location_desc( a.cmpny_div, concat( a.noti_lplc, a.noti_mplc, a.noti_splc )) as noti_splc_nm,
a.img_id1,
a.file_id1,
a.require_desc,
a.chk_emp_no,
a.chk_tel_no,
a.rec_asgn_cd,
a.noti_title,
a.noti_plc_desc,
a.chk_asgn_cd,

get_dept_info7( a.cmpny_div, a.act_bsns_cd, a.act_dept_cd, get_emp_info( a.cmpny_div, a.act_emp_no, 'ASGN_CD' ), 'ASGN_FULL_NM') AS act_asgn_nm,
GET_EMP_INFO(a.cmpny_div, a.act_emp_no, 'EMP_NM') as act_emp_nm,
a.act_emp_no,
a.act_tel_no,
a.act_asgn_cd,

a.approve_id,
a.sago_div_l_code,
a.sago_div_m_code,
a.sago_div_s_code,
a.app_same
FROM tfa2010c01 a
LEFT JOIN vzz1020c03 b
ON b.cmpny_div = a.cmpny_div
AND b.dept_cd = a.CHK_DEPT_CD
AND b.asgn_cd = a.CHK_ASGN_CD
LEFT JOIN vzz1020c03 c
ON c.cmpny_div = a.company
AND c.dept_cd = a.rec_dept_cd
AND c.asgn_cd = a.rec_asgn_cd
LEFT JOIN tb_com_systemcode d
ON d.cmpny_div = a.cmpny_div
AND d.all_sys_cd = a.cmpny_div || 'F120'
AND d.all_sys_cd = a.cmpny_div || 'F120' || a.subject_cd
LEFT JOIN tb_com_systemcode e
ON e.cmpny_div = a.cmpny_div
AND e.all_sys_cd = a.cmpny_div || 'F120'
AND e.all_sys_cd = a.cmpny_div || 'F120' || a.subject_cd || a.target_facility
LEFT JOIN tb_com_systemcode g
ON g.cmpny_div = a.cmpny_div
AND g.all_sys_cd = a.cmpny_div || 'B010'
AND g.all_sys_cd = a.cmpny_div || 'B010' || a.sago_div_m
LEFT JOIN tb_com_systemcode h
ON h.cmpny_div = a.cmpny_div
AND h.all_sys_cd = a.cmpny_div || 'F190'
AND h.all_sys_cd = a.cmpny_div || 'F190' || a.status
WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.cmpny_div = #{CMPNY_DIV}
AND a.company = #{CMPNY_DIV}
AND a.noti_dt
BETWEEN COALESCE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(#{NOTI_FROM}, ''), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMMDD'), '19000101')
AND COALESCE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(#{NOTI_TO}, ''), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMMDD'), '99991231')
AND (
b.bsns_cd = #{SEND_BSNS_CD}
OR (#{SEND_BSNS_CD} = 'AN00' AND b.bsns_cd = 'AC00')
)
AND a.chk_dept_cd = #{CHK_DEPT_CD}
AND a.CHK_ASGN_CD = #{CHK_ASGN_CD}
AND c.bsns_cd = #{REC_BSNS_CD}
AND a.rec_dept_cd = #{REC_DEPT_CD}
AND a.rec_asgn_cd = #{REC_ASGN_CD}
AND (
(
#{TYPE} = 'A'
AND (
#{STATUS} IS NULL OR #{STATUS} = ''
OR (#{STATUS} IS NOT NULL AND #{STATUS} != '' AND a.status = #{STATUS})
)
)
OR (
#{TYPE} = 'B'
AND (
(#{STATUS} IS NULL OR #{STATUS} = '' AND a.status > '20')
OR (#{STATUS} IS NOT NULL AND #{STATUS} != '' AND a.status = #{STATUS})
)
)
)
AND a.status = '40'
AND a.status = '30'
AND a.chk_emp_no = #{CHK_EMP_NO}
AND a.status = '30'
ORDER BY a.mng_no DESC
